summary: GetResourceFromHandle (lib/DxilValidation/DxilValidation.cpp:167-189) still both looks up resource properties and emits InstrHandleNotFromCreateHandle/InstrReorderCoherentRequiresSM69 as a side effect, unrenamed; GetSamplerKind, GetResourceKindAndCompTy and GetCBufSize -- the three functions the issue names -- still all call it rather than the silent GetResourceFromVal, so an invalid handle reaching e.g. GetDimensions still has the same error emitted twice (once from the up-front ValidateHandleArgs pass PR #5399 added, once from the op-specific accessor -- no early return between them). No ValidateResourceHandle function exists anywhere in the tree, and DxilResourceProperties::isValid() (include/dxc/DXIL/DxilResourceProperties.h:79) is never called from the validator; every call site hand-repeats getResourceClass()==Invalid instead. ValidateASHandle (DxilValidation.cpp:1572-1579, TraceRay's AS handle) already uses the pattern the issue asks for everywhere, confirming both styles coexist today. git log --all --grep for GetResourceFromHandle/ValidateResourceHandle/5448, and -S'ValidateResourceHandle', all return zero commits: no part of this refactor has ever been implemented. Filed by the reporter six minutes after their own PR #5399 merged; zero comments, zero cross-references. No dxc.exe command line or CE link exists for this issue: the one observable consequence (duplicate diagnostic) needs a handle Value absent from ResPropMap, which ordinary HLSL cannot construct -- confirmed directly, a control shader selecting between two Texture2D locals is rejected by dxc's legalizer (exit 0x80004005, an ordinary diagnosed error) before DXIL validation runs; reaching the validator's own path needs the standalone dxv validator, not built here and out of scope to build (no rebuilds permitted).
